skill.summary: HouseSigma 매물 데이터를 자동 및 수동으로 수집해 Hauscout SQLite DB에 저장하고 크론잡으로 주기적 업데이트를 지원합니다.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the HouseSigma Collector Skill.

- Collects HouseSigma listing data and saves to Hauscout SQLite DB.
- Supports automated, profile-based, and targeted collection via command-line options.
- Provides manual collection workflow using browser and DOM data mapping for custom data extraction.
- Includes instructions for managing search profiles and integrating collected data with the dashboard.
- Supports daily automated collection via cron, with built-in precautions for rate limiting and headless browsing.
- Detailed usage and maintenance guides are provided in the documentation.
